statement: The source-described full Joy-Con input report 0x30 uses right-side button bits at absolute byte 3, shared bits at 4, left-side button bits at 5, packed 12-bit left stick at 6-8, right stick at 9-11, and three signed six-axis samples starting at byte 13. The unused half-stick payload value is not established by these sources.
